item.title: nopCommerce Multi-Nodes in a Docker Swarm Cluster
item.description: An R&D journey to run nopCommerce across multiple nodes in a Docker Swarm cluster. The post walks through the failure modes and fixes I hit while scaling a stateful .NET Core monolith across three replicas behind a load balancer, with shared database, cache, and file storage.
